Invalid structure or values must raise `ValueError`.

import unittest
from copy import deepcopy

from solution import register_entries


class RegisterEntriesTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_registers_in_order_and_preserves_extra_store_data(self):
        store = {
            "items": [{"id": 2, "label": "old", "due_day": 1, "meta": ["x"]}],
            "next_id": 5,
            "settings": {"color": ["blue"]},
        }
        entries = [
            {"label": "  first  ", "due_day": 0, "ignored": [1]},
            {"label": "second", "due_day": 12},
        ]
        store_before = deepcopy(store)
        entries_before = deepcopy(entries)

        result = register_entries(store, entries)

        self.assertEqual(result["items"], [
            {"id": 2, "label": "old", "due_day": 1, "meta": ["x"]},
            {"id": 5, "label": "first", "due_day": 0},
            {"id": 6, "label": "second", "due_day": 12},
        ])
        self.assertEqual(result["next_id"], 7)
        self.assertIs(result["all_items"], result["items"])
        self.assertEqual(store, store_before)
        self.assertEqual(entries, entries_before)
        self.assertIsNot(result["items"], store["items"])
        self.assertIsNot(result["items"][0], store["items"][0])
        self.assertIsNot(result["items"][0]["meta"], store["items"][0]["meta"])
        self.assertIsNot(result["settings"], store["settings"])
        self.assertIsNot(result["settings"]["color"], store["settings"]["color"])

    def test_empty_iterable_returns_deep_copy_and_required_alias(self):
        store = {"items": [{"nested": []}], "next_id": 1, "extra": [1, 2]}
        result = register_entries(store, iter(()))
        self.assertEqual(result["items"], store["items"])
        self.assertEqual(result["next_id"], 1)
        self.assertIs(result["all_items"], result["items"])
        self.assertIsNot(result["items"], store["items"])
        self.assertIsNot(result["items"][0], store["items"][0])
        self.assertIsNot(result["items"][0]["nested"], store["items"][0]["nested"])
        self.assertIsNot(result["extra"], store["extra"])

    def test_generator_entries_are_supported(self):
        entries = ({"label": label, "due_day": day} for label, day in [("a", 1), ("b", 2)])
        result = register_entries({"items": [], "next_id": 10}, entries)
        self.assertEqual(result["items"], [
            {"id": 10, "label": "a", "due_day": 1},
            {"id": 11, "label": "b", "due_day": 2},
        ])

    def test_all_entries_are_validated_before_any_returned_result(self):
        store = {"items": [], "next_id": 3}
        entries = [
            {"label": "valid", "due_day": 1},
            {"label": "   ", "due_day": 2},
        ]
        before_store = deepcopy(store)
        before_entries = deepcopy(entries)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            register_entries(store, entries)
        self.assertEqual(store, before_store)
        self.assertEqual(entries, before_entries)

    def test_invalid_store_structures_raise_value_error(self):
        stores = [
            None,
            {},
            {"items": (), "next_id": 1},
            {"items": [], "next_id": 0},
            {"items": [], "next_id": True},
            {"items": [], "next_id": 1.0},
        ]
        for store in stores:
            with self.subTest(store=store):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    register_entries(store, [])

    def test_invalid_entries_raise_value_error(self):
        invalid_entries = [
            None,
            [None],
            [{}],
            [{"label": "x"}],
            [{"due_day": 1}],
            [{"label": "", "due_day": 1}],
            [{"label": 3, "due_day": 1}],
            [{"label": "x", "due_day": -1}],
            [{"label": "x", "due_day": True}],
            [{"label": "x", "due_day": 1.5}],
        ]
        for entries in invalid_entries:
            with self.subTest(entries=entries):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    register_entries({"items": [], "next_id": 1}, entries)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
